description_en: Queries a list of scaling plan jobs for an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
description_zh: 查询集群的弹性计划作业
name: DescribeElasticPlanJobs

parameters.help_en:
The name of the scaling plan.



If you do not specify this parameter, all scaling plans of the cluster are queried.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/601334.html operation to query the names of scaling plans
parameters.help_zh:
弹性计划名称。
不填写弹性计划名称将查询所有弹性计划。
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/601334.html接口查看集群的弹性计划名称
parameters.name: elastic_plan_name

parameters.help_en:
The name of the resource group.



If you do not specify this parameter, the scaling plans of all resource groups are queried, including the interactive resource group and elastic I/O unit (EIU) types.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459446.html operation to query the resource group name for a cluster
parameters.help_zh:
资源组名称。
不填写表示查询所有资源组的弹性计划，包括Interactive资源组类型和存储加速服务（EIU）。
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459446.html接口可以查看集群的资源组名称
parameters.name: resource_group_name

parameters.help_en:
The state of the scaling plan job. Valid values:

RUNNING
SUCCESSFUL
FAILED

If you do not specify this parameter, the scaling plans in all states are queried
parameters.help_zh:
作业状态。
取值说明：
RUNNING：运行中。
SUCCESSFUL：运行成功。
FAILED：运行失败。
不填写将查询所有状态的弹性计划
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口可以查看集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

ElasticAcu.description_en:
The amount of elastic resources.



If Type is set to EXECUTOR, ElasticAcu indicates the amount of elastic resources in the current resource group.

If Type is set to WORKER, ElasticAcu indicates the total amount of elastic storage resources in the current cluster
ElasticAcu.description_zh:
弹性资源。
Type取值为EXECUTOR时，本参数表示当前资源组的弹性资源。
Type取值为WORKER时，本参数表示当前集群的总存储弹性资源

ElasticPlanName.description_en: The name of the scaling plan

EndTime.description_en:
The end time of the scaling plan job.

The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss format. The time is displayed in UTC
EndTime.description_zh:
作业结束时间。

格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

InstanceSize.description_en:
The number of compute nodes or storage replica sets.



If Type is set to EXECUTOR, InstanceSize indicates the number of compute nodes in the cluster.

If Type is set to EXECUTOR, InstanceSize indicates the number of storage replica sets in the cluster
InstanceSize.description_zh:
实例数量。
Type取值为EXECUTOR时，本参数表示当前计算节点数量。
Type取值为WORKER时，本参数表示当前集群的存储副本集数量

ReserveAcu.description_en:
The amount of reserved resources.



If Type is set to EXECUTOR, ReserveAcu indicates the amount of reserved resources in the current resource group.

If Type is set to WORKER, ReserveAcu indicates the total amount of reserved storage resources in the current cluster
ReserveAcu.description_zh:
预留资源。
Type取值为EXECUTOR时，本参数表示当前资源组的预留资源。
Type取值为WORKER时，本参数表示当前集群的总预留存储资源

ResourceGroupName.description_en: The name of the resource group

StartTime.description_en:
The start time of the scaling plan job.

The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss format. The time is displayed in UTC
StartTime.description_zh:
作业开始时间。
格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

Status.description_en:
The state of the scaling plan job. Valid values:

RUNNING
SUCCESSFUL
FAILED
Status.description_zh:
作业状态。
取值说明：
RUNNING：运行中。
SUCCESSFUL：运行成功。
FAILED：运行失败

TargetSize.description_en: The desired specifications of elastic resources after scaling

TotalAcu.description_en:
The total amount of resources.



If Type is set to EXECUTOR, TotalAcu indicates the total amount of computing resources in the current resource group.

If Type is set to WORKER, TotalAcu indicates the total amount of storage resources in the cluster
TotalAcu.description_zh:
总资源。
Type取值为EXECUTOR时，本参数表示所属资源组的总计算资源。
Type取值为WORKER时，本参数表示整个集群的总存储资源

Type.description_en:
The type of the scaling plan job. Valid values:

EXECUTOR: the interactive resource group type, which indicates the computing resource type.
WORKER: the EIU type
Type.description_zh:
弹性计划作业类型。
取值说明：
EXECUTORE：Interactive资源组类型，即计算资源类型。
WORKER：存储加速服务（EIU）

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of scaling plan jobs
